request: Where is order ORD-1007? It should have arrived by now.

steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its promised delivery date, fulfillment status, items, and warehouse.
Since the order is marked SHIPPED and is past its promised delivery date, I will pull the shipment tracking to see status, ETA, and any recorded delay reason.

recommended_actions.details: Ask Atlanta Distribution Center (WH-ATL) to immediately create/correct the shipment record for ORD-1007 (carrier, tracking number, and dispatch date) and confirm whether it was physically handed to the carrier; evidence: get_shipment_status NOT_FOUND and get_order_details shows fulfillment_status SHIPPED with promised_delivery_date 2026-03-13 now past.

Inform Litware Inc that ORD-1007 is delayed past the promised date (2026-03-13) and tracking is not yet available; advise that we are expediting resolution with WH-ATL and will share the tracking number and updated ETA as soon as it is provided. Evidence: get_order_details is_past_promised_date true.

Once WH-ATL provides the tracking number, contact the carrier to request a shipment trace and confirmed ETA because the order is already overdue. This follows from get_order_details showing it is past promised date and the prior absence of tracking.

arguments.recommendation: Escalate to WH-ATL to generate/verify the shipment record and tracking, notify the customer of the delay now, and, once tracking is available, contact the carrier for a trace and confirmed ETA.
